coupon-noop.symptom: Coupon is accepted, but the discount is missing
coupon-noop.cause: The coupon is stored and shown as active (toast and chip), but the totals calculation never receives it.

remove-off-by-one.symptom: The wrong item disappears from the cart
remove-off-by-one.cause: Removing deletes the entry at index + 1 instead of the selected index.

qty-stale-total.symptom: Totals lag one click behind after a quantity change
qty-stale-total.cause: Totals are calculated from the previous cart state instead of the new one.

filter-ignored.symptom: "In stock only" is active, but the list still shows everything
filter-ignored.cause: The filter chip toggles its state, but the filter predicate never evaluates it.

submit-disabled.symptom: "Place order" stays grey although every field is filled in
submit-disabled.cause: The email validation does not trim; the prefilled address from the customer import ends with a space.

save-not-persisted.symptom: The saved address is gone after a reload
save-not-persisted.cause: The save handler only updates React state; the write to localStorage is missing.

double-submit.symptom: An order is sometimes placed twice
double-submit.cause: The order button is not locked while the request is pending; a double-click creates two orders.

flaky-race.symptom: An item sometimes does not end up in the cart
flaky-race.cause: Every third "Add to cart" click is dropped while the success toast still appears.
